title: CIP-179 free-text answer
description: The answer to a CIP-179 custom (tag 0) question that asks for free text. The answer metadatum is the text as chunked_text: either one text string of at most 64 UTF-8 bytes, or a non-empty array of such strings whose concatenation is the answer. The full text is at most maxUtf8Bytes UTF-8 bytes long.
